items.summary: perf(sessions): serve remaining per-turn session authority reads from workers (#165028) * perf(sessions): serve remaining per-turn session authority reads from workers Move current chat admission, reply authority, lifecycle preparation, verbosity, and maintenance reads through existing workers. Retain physical source identity and foreign-commit freshness, preserve accepted lifecycle settlement through close, and carry prepared transcript selection facts. * refactor(sessions): finish async admission cutover Join accepted event batches and listener settlement in fixtures. Keep restart metadata preparation with the work-admission owner and make callback this contracts explicit. * test(sessions): drain the merged event subscription fixture Use the existing async-aware event subscription helper in the consolidated verbosity test. The previous merge retained the plain unsubscribe callback while awaiting its drain method, causing a TypeError before the assertions. The corrected event-handler file passes all 82 tests. Together with the four unchanged passing files, the integrated focused group covers 163 cases. The one-line fixture correction is clean through P2 autoreview. * test(gateway): finish async lifecycle fixture cutover Await asynchronous agent-event consumers and projection disposal. Move lifecycle fault injection to prepared callbacks, and track accepted writes through owner-controlled persistence before fixture cleanup. Initialize runtime config before observing row publications. * test(gateway): preserve lifecycle fixture module exports Use partial mocks for lifecycle preparation, session entry writes, and worker reads. Remove the three obsolete mock-factory baseline entries. The five affected tests, typed core lint, mock-export scanner, and P2 review pass. * test(gateway): serialize malformed-row fixture writes Join the physical-store writer queue before inserting the malformed fixture row. Session replacement starts asynchronous maintenance; an uncoordinated synchronous host write can block the admission callback a worker needs to release its SQLite lock. Preserve the raw bytes, post-admission position, lack of publication, and all assertions. The original lock reproduced in CI and one of five head controls; the targeted repaired case, typed lint, formatting, and P2 review pass. The separate slow handle-cap case remains recorded in local controls. * test(gateway): settle Talk fixture lifecycle work before reseeding Join observed request and root work, accepted lifecycle preparation, and transcript publication before clearing the shared Talk fixture. Writer queue draining alone cannot see preparation still waiting on worker reads. Reuse the existing observer and preparation tracker; preserve every Talk behavior assertion and the real persistence path. A controlled probe showed cleanup could outpace accepted preparation, but did not identify the exact CI conflicting writer. The repaired Node 24 full file passes all eight cases; its exact CI merge/shard composition passes all 297 tests. Typed lint, formatting, and P2 review pass. No timer, retry, production API, or per-test Gateway boot is added. * test(reply): isolate Slack lease cleanup from admission readiness Keep request admission on its real scheduler and control only post-resolver handoff and final settlement with fake time. Replace the one-second resolver poll with an explicit owned gate, preserve delivery assertions, and verify lease release at its configured 25 ms bound. Move the unchanged Slack fixture into the existing harness to satisfy the line cap. All 132 dispatch cases pass; an omitted final release still fails the lease assertion; P2 review is clean. * test(gateway): share private completion recorder assertions Move the unchanged recorder checks into existing private-completion fixture support while preserving the parent callback and current-session binding. This resolves the Testbox line-cap failure without removing assertions or changing deadlines. Full private-completion proof passes 23 cases in 338.21 seconds; typed lint, line cap, formatting, and P2 review pass. * refactor(meetings): keep fixture-only types in test support * test(gateway): reuse session projection fixture seeds * test(gateway): construct complete exporter method descriptors Use the production plugin descriptor constructor so the synthetic RPC fixture supplies the required profileAccess contract. The handler-map conversion helper returns input descriptors intended for later normalization, not the completed descriptors stored by the plugin registry. Keep the same lazy handlers, method names, admin scope, and runtime assertions. The exact failing root-test type graph and all ten method-registry cases pass. * test(gateway): align projection fixture comment with main * fix(sessions): fence sharing snapshots after writer admission A row publication before ordered FIFO admission describes state the coming snapshot will include. Starting the outer fence earlier can exhaust its refresh budget and reject current sharing facts before dispatch starts. Validate retained discovery and begin the caller fence after every selected FIFO is admitted, before the first snapshot. Keep physical-store, alias, source, and revocation fencing active during capture and consumption. The new callback is internal and performs no SQL or database admission. A real-membership regression fails on the previous owner and passes after this change. Existing lookup, ordered-read, and pending-input owner suites pass, as do all 12 ACP completion cases locally. The isolated regression takes 11.98s wall time including wrapper setup; no timeout, retry, or assertion was weakened. Scoped lint, types, and P2 review pass.

items.title: Rust預告停止32位元Windows主機工具，開發者需改採交叉編譯
items.summary: Rust團隊預告，從Rust 1.100開始，不再替32位元Windows提供可直接執行的Rust編譯器等開發工具。開發者仍可製作32位元Windows程式，但之後必須改在64位元Windows等受支援的電腦上完成編譯，再產生供32位元Windows執行的程式。

items.title: AI導致低品質報告氾濫，arXiv將限制報告每月提交最多2篇
items.summary: 由於AI生成的低品質報告氾濫造成管理負擔，知名論文發布平臺arXiv上周更新論文發布規範，限制每個月每人僅能提交最多2篇論文，而審稿論文最多只能有3篇論文。
